subject.title: fix(brave): use own-property checks for credential field lookups

question: Should Brave credential resolution enforce own-property checks across every segment of both supported credential paths before this hardening is merged?
rationale: The patch's stated security boundary covers prototype-chain credential injection, but the current implementation protects only the terminal fields; an owner should confirm whether the complete path must be hardened or the narrower residual risk is intentionally accepted.

options.title: Harden the complete paths
options.body: Require own-property traversal for every intermediate and terminal segment, with regression proof for both plugin and legacy paths.

options.title: Accept terminal-only protection
options.body: Merge only after explicitly narrowing the threat model and documenting that inherited intermediate objects remain trusted.

recommendation.title: Harden the complete paths
recommendation.body: Require own-property traversal for every intermediate and terminal segment, with regression proof for both plugin and legacy paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Brave plugin and credential descriptor were introduced by this owner signal in the latest feature extraction.
